subject: Quinna
fact: Quinna is delighted and promises to throw the most fantastic feast on the 30th of this month, and to host you and your friends.
source_quote: Quinna is delighted: "Yes! I will throw the most fantastic feast on the 30th of this month! And I promised a feast for you and your friends."

subject: kitchen
fact: Glennon Clee walks up to him as he stands near the kitchen.
source_quote: As he stands near the kitchen, Glennon Clee walks up to him - "Did you find my barrels?"

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia looks at him and says, "No."
source_quote: Zinnia looks at him and says, "No."
